sources.label: Olivine abundance
sources.notes: Coverage 50S-50N. Numeric service and samples report 0.25-degree spacing (~7.6 km at equator), despite source imagery advertised at 512 ppd (~59 m). A fine pixelSize request still returned 0.25 degree. Four mineral raw fractions sum to approximately one at all three probe locations, whereas FGDC calls them wt%. Multiply by 100 only under an explicit, reviewed normalization; do not label raw 0.066 as 0.066 wt%.

sources.label: Clinopyroxene abundance
sources.notes: Coverage 50S-50N. Numeric service and samples report 0.25-degree spacing (~7.6 km at equator), despite source imagery advertised at 512 ppd (~59 m). A fine pixelSize request still returned 0.25 degree. Same fraction-versus-wt% scaling issue as olivine.

sources.label: Orthopyroxene abundance

sources.label: Iron oxide abundance
sources.notes: Coverage 50S-50N. Numeric service and samples report 0.25-degree spacing (~7.6 km at equator), despite source imagery advertised at 512 ppd (~59 m). A fine pixelSize request still returned 0.25 degree. FGDC explicitly defines FeO wt%; raw samples are approximately 6.8-20.4 in this audit.

sources.label: Submicroscopic metallic iron abundance
sources.notes: Coverage 50S-50N. Numeric service and samples report 0.25-degree spacing (~7.6 km at equator), despite source imagery advertised at 512 ppd (~59 m). A fine pixelSize request still returned 0.25 degree. Raw 2.9-6.9; source labels do not resolve the raw service scaling. Do not publish a physical abundance yet.

sources.label: Optical maturity index (OMAT)
sources.notes: Coverage 50S-50N. Numeric service and samples report 0.25-degree spacing (~7.6 km at equator), despite source imagery advertised at 512 ppd (~59 m). A fine pixelSize request still returned 0.25 degree. Space-weathering/composition context; not an Earth soil-maturity index.

sources.label: Modeled plagioclase grain size

sources.label: Mineral-model weighted fit criterion
sources.notes: Coverage 50S-50N. Numeric service and samples report 0.25-degree spacing (~7.6 km at equator), despite source imagery advertised at 512 ppd (~59 m). A fine pixelSize request still returned 0.25 degree. Quality/provenance channel, not a resource or environmental score. NaN observed at one probe; no universal quality cutoff established.
